title: Engine Operator Guide | ContextMint Docs
description: Operate ContextMint Engine — Overview, Server, Ollama, Models, Indexing, Quality, Knowledge, Logs, Settings, and support bundle.
lead: ContextMint Engine is the desktop tray app that manages the Python API server, Ollama, indexing jobs, and operator diagnostics. Developers use VS Code for daily chat; operators and leads use Engine for health and capacity.

lifecycle.title: Tray & lifecycle
items: Start all — API server + Ollama (local-first)
Stop all — graceful shutdown; extension shows offline
Autostart options in Settings (OS service / login — platform-dependent)

overview.title: Overview tab
items: Readiness — server, Ollama, Redis (if used), data layer notes
Workspaces — registered repos, indexing state, drill-down to Indexing / Quality
Chat lanes (session) — Repo / Work / Hybrid stream counts and Work-lane suggest metrics

server.title: Server tab
items: Port and bind address (default loopback)
Restart server without quitting Engine
Link to /api/health for raw health JSON

ollama.title: Ollama tab
items: Runtime status and URL
Restart Ollama process
First-run: install link if binary not found

models.title: Models tab
items: Installed models vs available pulls
Embed model used for indexing (changing it may require reindex)
Default chat model for local routing
Vision models — pull moondream, llava, or qwen2-vl for screenshot Q&A and ARGUS audits

indexing.title: Indexing tab
items: Per-workspace progress, file counts, errors
Manual reindex / activate workspace actions
Drill-down for file-level status on large repos

quality.title: Quality tab
items: Run quality scans (clones, structure signals)
Findings feed governance drawer in VS Code
Scan progress for long-running repos

knowledge.title: Knowledge tab
knowledge.before: Browse index-time Knowledge Layer registries and tail redacted activity audit events — the operator complement to VS Code governance. See
knowledge.after: for worked examples, persistence (Structure is not time-limited; Activity UI defaults to a 1–24 h window), and screenshot checklist.
items: Structure — routes, services, documents, sections, policies; searchable table + graph preview
Activity — audit JSONL tail (governance_fast_path, chat streams, actions); export JSON

logs.title: Logs tab
items: Tail server logs with time window filter
Use when chat or indexing fails intermittently

settings.title: Settings tab
items: Python path, backend bundle path
Server URL override, Ollama URL

Server Config — full YAML catalog (agent, review, AG-INTEL, Planning PAEP/Plan Studio/EPA, SS-MU, governance, inference, …) grouped for operators; Studio and EPA defaults stay off until dogfood default-on
Changes write ~/.contextmint/server.defaults.yaml — restart server after Apply

budget.title: Context budget
budget.before: Open Context budget in the Engine nav to set max_context_tokens (RAG ship cap) and co-apply max_gen_tokens (answer length / Ollama num_predict) for your hardware tier. Values are saved to ~/.contextmint/server.defaults.yaml; restart server after Apply.

about.title: About & support bundle
about.before: Export a support bundle (versions, config redacted, recent logs) when filing
